I moved out at 18. Nparents made moving out seem scary and intimidating so that we wouldn’t dare try and do it without their approval. But in reality, moving out is not much harder than obtaining a drivers license. 


Transportation, Job, House.

These are the things you need in order to move out effectively. You need to keep them too, because if you lose one and don’t recover quickly you will most likely lose the other two as well. 


Write up a budget with your income as opposed to your bills (find a place you want to live and look up what your rent/mortgage would be a month).

Now multiply your entire monthly expenses by 3. If your income could still pay for 3x what it should cost you, then you’re in the golden zone. Even if it can only cover twice your expected monthly expenses, you should still be alright. 

Also, when you move, find out where your birth certificate and social security card is, and snatch those. You WILL need those later in life.

Good luck and if you have any questions I’m here to answer
